Title: 'VideoGPT+: Integrating Image and Video Encoders for Enhanced Video Understanding'
Abstract: We present VideoGPT+, a unified video understanding model that combines image and video encoders.

Title: 'An Image is Worth More Than 16x16 Patches: Exploring Transformers on Individual Pixels'
Abstract: Pixel-level transformers exceed patch-level baselines on dense prediction benchmarks.

Title: 'Interpreting the Weight Space of Customized Diffusion Models'
Abstract: We probe the weight space of personalized diffusion models and identify interpretable directions.
